tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzungs grwa lnga rdo rje phreng ba lugs kyi bdag 'jug bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'dir thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gzungs grwa lnga'i sgrub dkyil cho gar nye bar mkho ba'i bdag 'jug len tshul nag 'gros su bkod pa ni/ las bum mam dung chos su chu thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī hūm̐ bar gyis 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi sogs maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i mthar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje 'gro ba'i sogs 'dra/ /skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon sogs nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol bar 'dra/ oṃ zhes brjod pas rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa thor cog tu byas pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri nas swāhā/ tshar gcig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhī a laṅka ra wasatra pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ smad g.yogs dmar po gyon par mos/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ gis stod g.yogs sngon po bsam/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis thor cog bcings par bsam/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma na ye hūm̐/ gis gdong 'ching tshul/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ gis me tog len tshul/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/

las bum gyi chus gtor te/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs nas swāhās bsangs/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ de rnams las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing dag hūm̐ rang nyid dkyil 'khor shar sgor 'khod/ kyai dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ /ci la dga' zhes dang / bde chen bdag ni skal bzang la'o/ /rang gi thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ snying khar me tog rdo rje dang bcas pa reg oṃ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya tha suḥkhaṃ/ zhes bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag te/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra ba mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang mi bya'o/ /zhes phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang 'jug gi slad du/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor phyogs la mgo dud pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥya man+ta kṛta hūm̐/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'dod pa'i snam bu'i steng na phar yid kyis g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar du byas par mos/

ma hā ra ta su ḍi dha su twa ṣ+wa su su ṣ+wa badz+ra satwa ad+ya sid+dhi māṃ/ zhes bskor ba tha ma de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod pas mos nas phyag bya ba ni/ mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje thal mo brkyangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la byin gyis brlab par gsol ba'i yid kyis lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a saṣ+ṭha nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mi bskyod pa gnyis pa zhig mched de/ snying khar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos/ slar yang de nyid nas rnam snang gi nga rgyal gyis rdo rje thal mo brkyangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la byin gyis rlabs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis lus thams cad sa la phab pas phyag bya bar mos/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pū dza u sas+d+ya na ya/ at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las rnam snang gnyis pa zhig mched de/ snying khar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'dod pa'i snam bus steng nas phar las g.yas skor gyis lho sgo nas rin 'byung gi nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying khar sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis dpral ba sa la reg pa'i phyag bya bar mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ta āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las rin 'byung gnyis pa zhig mched de/ dpral bar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos/ slar yang sogs nas/ nub sgo nas 'od dpag med kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba'i yid kyis kha sa la reg pas phyag byas par mos/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza pra war+dha nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma tsakra pra war+dha ya maṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las 'od dpag med gnyis pa zhig mched de/ mgrin par thim pa sogs nas/ byang sgo nas don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying khar sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams bdag la phrin las bzhi gsol ba'i yid kyis spyi bo sa la reg pas phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza karma ne at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ku ru maṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las don grub gnyis pa zhig mched de/ spyi bor thim pas sogs nas shar sgor 'khod/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo rje btsun ma la sems can gyi don 'grub par mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la lus thams cad sa la reg pa phyag byas par mos/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇa pu dza u saṣ+ṭha nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba satwa pa ri pra ṇar+thā ma āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo las gtso mo gnyis pa zhig mched de/ snying khar thim pas sems can gyi don 'grub par byin gyis brlabs par mos/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du/ sogs 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal gzungs grwa lnga'i lha tshogs rnams bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum/ sems kyi phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ myong yang bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu'i de nyid du/ nges par byas nas/ āḥzhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa 'dzin pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa thor cog tu byas pa la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo skya rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i sku lus 'degs bzhin pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa gsal btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma lta bu 'phros pas rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas lus rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'dar yed yed gnas pa'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das so sor 'brang ma'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te snying khar thim/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las kyang de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste rang gi snying khar thim/ yang 'od zer tshad med pa du ma 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshad med grangs med pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes dang / rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing / 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su brjod/ /rdo rje'i ye shes bla na med/ /de ring khyod la 'bebs par mdzad/ tshar gcig oṃ badz+ra a bi sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes mang du brjod cing dbab bo/ /de ltar ye shes phab pa/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag te/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la 'dod snam gyi steng nas bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar du byas par mos/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs lan gsum brjod cing mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod par mos/

de nas lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprad pa'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal gdab cing bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug pa 'di/ /lha rnams kyis ni rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams gsal btab ste/ de rnams las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang bas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par mos shing / oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa twa me bha wa/ hri da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha ha ha ha ha ho/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añtsa li nā tha hoḥ zhes me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti grih+na satwaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes spyi bor bcings/ mig gnyis su oṃ/ snying khar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ yig rnams gsal btab/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /thams cad spyan ni 'byed par mdzad/ oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig ras lhan cig tu bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor lta bar bskul ba ni/ /da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ste nyid la ltos/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi/ /gsang sngags rnams la bsgrub par gyis/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ bcom ldan 'das/ so sor 'brang ma lha bcu gsum gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du mthong ba yin no/

/bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas par bsam ste/ oṃ rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ni bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho ho/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs gong bzhin la/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru do tsam dpag pa'i sar dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa sgo gcig nub tu bstan pa/ dkar dmar nag pa'i ra ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i nang du lha rnams rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus su mtshan ma dang bral ba/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri rnams kyis mtshan pa/ snam bu la bum pa la sogs pa bkod pa'i dbus su shing stan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma sku mdog ser mo sogs nas/ bzhugs pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung dang 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ oṃ āḥhrī pra ba ra sarka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/

/de ltar 'di la gnang bar zhu/ lan gcig thugs ka nas bye ba'i gtso mo phyag gnyis pa gcig byon te/ sbyong ba mdzad par bsam ste/ sbyong chas bshams pa la las bum gyis chu gtor/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs brjod/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang dbang len pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad yungs kar gyis sbyangs/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ g.yas su bskor yang oṃ sarba sogs g.yon du bskor oṃ sarba sogs gnyis kas g.yas su bskor/ oṃ sarba sogs gnyis kas g.yon du bskor zhing me dang chu nang du dor ro/ /de bzhin du chus sbyangs/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces chu nang du me cung zad blug go /kham phor dkar po so ma btang bas sbyangs/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ ba ci'i changs bu dang durba'i myu gus sbyangs/ oṃ sarba ma la a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zan changs dang ting lo me 'bar bzhin pas sbyangs/ oṃ puṇ+ye dzñā na dha ro saṃ bhod+dha ka ye swāhā/ seng ras dkar pos sbyang bar mos/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ rdzas drug po 'di/ dbang po drug gi glud du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs dang las sngags brjod cing phyir dor bar mos/ de nas nye reg bya ba'i don du tsog pur 'dug pa'i pus mo gnyis kyi bar du khyor mor chu bzung / g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis chu blangs te kha'i ze 'bru la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su nye reg byas pas 'bag pa dang ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyang bar mos nas/ kha'i ze'u 'bru la lan gsum/ mig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna bug gnyis/ mchu gnyis/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ mgo bo'i steng / lto ba la byabs pa'i tshul bya/ mthar kha bshal nas g.yon phyogs nas phyir 'pho te g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi rgyab kyis kha'i gsher rnams g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyi tshul bya skabs/

oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes mang du brjod/ so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥpra wa ra sarka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dī pāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes hūm̐ rjes mar spos rgya/ las bum gyis chu gtor te/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ris bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las glang pos btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ lan gnyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyis lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rgyud byin gyis brlabs te dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul ba dang bcas pas me tog gi char phab cing / bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol bar gyur/ ces dang bum pa btegs te/ rdor dril 'dzin pas me tog gtor zhing / bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kun gyi rje/ /ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po nyid/ /bkra shis kyis ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ zhes pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas bum pa bzung / g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka ṇa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no pa/ ḍ-i ḍ+yo me bha wa/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ/ zhes spyi bor bum pa bzhag mthar bum chu 'thung / zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag rgyud la bde chen ye shes mngon du byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ gis mchod nas/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa yin no/ /des 'og ma bzhi la rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du sogs nas/ rta mchog gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du traṃ las rin po che cha dgu pa'i lte bar trāṃ gis zhes pa nas gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che cha dgu pa dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/

zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas cod pan du gyur par mos/ dbang bskur ba'i slad du zhes pa nas bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod pan re thogs te/ skye bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar btugs te dbang bskur bar mos/ ral pa'i thor gtsug gis brgyan pa'i/ /rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyang cod pan dag gi dbang / /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku tra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tshar gcig oṃ badz+ra dha tī shā+o ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ spyi bo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+rūṃ/ dpral ba/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rna ltag g.yas/ oṃ dharma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag pa/ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su dbu rgyan reg rjes gyon/ kha dog lnga pa'i dar dpyangs/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥzhes dbang bskur nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par mos/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na saṃ bha wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i zhes pa nas/ rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥyis mtshan pa las/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa 'dzin pa zhes pa nas/ gsol ba btab nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhes pa nas rdo rje re thogs nas snying mgrin spyi bo rnams su gtugs te mthar g.yas su byin ste/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zungs/ /oṃ ma hā su khaṃ badz+ra hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu sogs nas mos/ oṃ a mṛ ta bha wā sa pa ri wā ra sogs nas/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob pa yin no/ /don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang sogs nas/ nam mkha' lding gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar a yis mtshan pa sogs nas/ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin zhes pa nas/ g.yon du byin te/ chos kyi dril bu bla na med/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrog pas/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes dbang bskur nas sngar gyi rdor dril lhan cig thugs kar bsnol nas rdo rje 'chang gi nga rgyal gyis lus kyi nang thams cad byang chub sems kyis gang bar mos/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ.āḥ bcom ldan gzung ngo bdag la ni/ /yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod/ tshar gcig gis nga rgyal bzung nas de nyid brtan pa'i sogs nas/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi sa pa ri wā ra sogs/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob pa yin no/ /rnam snang ming gi dbang bskur ba'i sogs nas seng ges btegs pa'i sogs nas/ oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs nas/ gyur pa las rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bsnams/ sogs nas/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar sogs nas mos/ rdor dril spyi bor dkrol te/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur nas/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba'i/ /ming gi dbang ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal che ge mo/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chu sogs/ oṃ bai ro tsa na sa pa ri wā ra sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /de ltar na me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang la sogs pa thob pas spang bya zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spang zhing / gnyen po ye shes lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud 'chad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i theg pa'i rgyud sde rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por rab tu gnas par byas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhāḥzhes brjod cing me tog gtor te dbu rgyan sogs bsdu'o/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ sngags kyi bzlas lung zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen po'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du praṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ste zhal nas thon rang gi zhal du zhugs/

thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod/ ces dang / oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs/ lan gsum brjod/ me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bdag la bsgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /'di la bsgo bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs mig thur byin brlabs/ g.yon par dbu 'dzin tshul/ g.yas rdo rjes mig 'byed tshul byas la/ mthu ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib gsal/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib gsal/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥpraṃ/ a las skyes pa'i me long bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /de ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas med par/ /chos rnams de ltar shes nas khyod/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /skyobs pa rnams kyi sras su skye/ /gang yang rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni kun tu 'gro bar shes par gyis shig hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga satwaṃ/ zhes pas byin/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu mda' 'phen tshul byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ris bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje gsor zhing / 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra yā mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes byin pa'i rdo rje de spyi bor bzung / deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa thul la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la gnas par gyis shig lung bstan pa ni/ g.yon pas chos gos snam sbyar gyi grwa ri dwags bag phebs pa'i rna ba ltar dang g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kyai dpal che ge mo/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhud+dhu ba swa/ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra he du maṃ/ zhes rkang 'og tu 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ zhes lag g.yas su dung / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe āḥ zhes g.yon du dril bu/ āḥlag gnyis bar du pu sti byin par bsam la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor ba/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi dung ni bla na med/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ zhes pa ni chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin/

rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya rnams byas la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du/ chos kyi/ gnas su/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs/ zhes pa kha spo zhing / de ltar na sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo la sogs rnams bskor la sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus sgra sgrogs bshad pa gyis shig rin chen sna bdun gyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ ma 'ongs pa na thub pa'i dbang po yi/ /go 'phang thob phyir 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i dbang phyug bla med thob phyir du/ rin chen sna bdun rjes gnang sbyin par bya/ oṃ sap+ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dang / the tshom med pa'i bsam pa yis/ khyod 'di blo gros ngan mi bya/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul mchog 'di/ /mnyam med rang gis rab gsal bya/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ phan btags byas pa gzo bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ /skyon med dogs pa bral ba yis/ /de ltar sems can don gyis shig /rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis lus la rgyan gos bzang pos brgyan/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can re thogs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar du byas par mos/ ma hā ra ta sogs brjod/ gdugs dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas logs su bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag lan gsum byas pa'i tha mar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul bar mos nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud tsam byas la/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/

/de ltar phul bas dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par gyur/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /deng 'dir khyod rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad khyod la 'chi ba med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu mtha' 'grub bo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro/ /khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'dod pa kun la spyod pa khyod/ /gang la'ang 'jig med spyad par gyis/ /slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis/ /mi bya cung zad yod ma yin/ /ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin/ /'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster brtan par gyis/ /'gro la bde ba nyung las rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas/ sogs spyi 'gre/ rdo rje 'dzin/ dril bu gsil/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan nas/ kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog/ //bar lan gsum bya'o/ /zhes pa sa skya pa kun blos bris// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
